design_philosophy: Warm, grounded, and deeply human. Emphasizes connection and sustainable change through natural tones, generous spacing, and organic asymmetry.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium text-[#2A3026]
scales.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-[1.1] font-medium text-[#2A3026]

buttons.primary: bg-[#8A9A86] hover:bg-[#748570] text-[#F9F6F0] px-8 py-4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: border border-[#8A9A86] text-[#2A3026] hover:bg-[#8A9A86] hover:text-[#F9F6F0] px-8 py-4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 font-medium

cards.style: bg-[#F4EFE6] rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-12 transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 border border-transparent hover:border-[#D1C9BC]

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#D1C9BC] rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:border-[#8A9A86] focus:ring-0 text-[#2A3026] placeholder:text-[#8D9289] transition-colors

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#F9F6F0]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#D1C9BC]/50 transition-all duration-300

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1 or -translate-y-2) on cards and images. Buttons use smooth background transitions.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-4 to 0) using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Parallax effect on background images (using framer-motion useScroll).
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, organic continuous marquee for therapeutic approaches using 'react-fast-marquee'.

images.description: Warm, approachable portrait of Natalie holding a coffee cup, conveying human connection.
images.alt_text: Natalie C Bull - Mental Health Social Worker

images.description: Calming nature scene representing the Byron Bay region, grounding the about section.
Woman performing yoga in nature, representing yoga and mindfulness service.
Close-up of hands painting abstract art, representing art therapy.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5, soft and elegant icons.

sections_structure.name: Header
sections_structure.content: Logo (Natalie C Bull), Navigation (About, Services, Approach, Contact), CTA (Book Consultation).

sections_structure.name: Hero
sections_structure.content: Asymmetric layout. Overline: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker / AOD Counsellor. Headline: Meaningful, sustainable change. Subhead: Therapeutic alliance and human connection in Northern NSW. Primary CTA: Let's Connect. Image: hero_portrait.
sections_structure.layout_notes: Use a subtle sage green (#8A9A86) abstract shape blob or large rounded rectangle behind the portrait to add organic depth.

sections_structure.name: Therapeutic Approaches Marquee
sections_structure.content: CBT • Motivational Interviewing • ACT • Art Therapy • Mindfulness
sections_structure.layout_notes: Very slow, continuous marquee. Serif font. Warm sand background with dark olive text.

sections_structure.name: About
sections_structure.content: Title: Rooted in human connection. Bio: 30+ years experience across government & non-government sectors (including NSW Health). Identifying strengths & supporting clients. Upcoming training in Psychedelic-Assisted Therapy (2026). Image: about_nature_byron.
sections_structure.layout_notes: Split 50/50 layout. High line-height for body text for readability. Generous padding.

sections_structure.name: Services
sections_structure.content: Cards for: Mental Health Counselling, AOD Counselling, Yoga & Mindfulness. Highlight qualifications in a sleek list alongside or below.
sections_structure.layout_notes: Bento grid or 3-column. Use service_yoga and service_art_therapy images subtly within cards or as hover reveals.

sections_structure.name: Qualifications
sections_structure.content: Master of Social Work, Bachelor of Social Science, Postgraduate Certificate in Art Therapy, Diploma of Yoga Teaching.
sections_structure.layout_notes: Minimalist list with subtle top borders for each item. Very clean.

sections_structure.name: Contact
sections_structure.content: Contact form for bookings. Fields: Name, Email, Service Interest, Message.
sections_structure.layout_notes: Warm, earthy form. Custom input styling using Tailwind border-b instead of full boxes. Soft sage focus states.

sections_structure.name: Footer
sections_structure.content: Large Let's Talk CTA. Socials/Contact Info. Location: Northern NSW (Byron Bay region).
sections_structure.layout_notes: Massive padding (py-32). Dark olive background, bone white text. High contrast.

technical_instructions.component_strategy: Use raw HTML+Tailwind for organic structural layouts (Hero, About, Marquee). Use heavily customized Shadcn components for Form, Inputs, and Buttons.
technical_instructions.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios pass WCAG AA. All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
technical_instructions.font_imports: Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.
